notes.title: Updates and new game!
notes.content: [p]Hello my friends![/p][p]A new update is coming for the game with [b]improved graphics and Bug fixes[/b] soon next month and also coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in an enhanced edition![/p][p] [/p][p]Meanwhile if you want to check out our [b]new upcoming adventure game[/b][/p][p]check it out, follow and add to wishlist here![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499550/Mai_Child_of_Ages/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]In this game you'll follow Mai on her journey through a shattered world as she searches for her identity and the origin of the mysterious creatures that threaten the balance of the universe.[/p][h3][/h3][p][b]Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Set sail with Mai and travel through time, journeying across both past and future, thanks to a Sacred Plant that bridges time and space.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Observe how the world transforms before your eyes and adapt your actions accordingly.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3499550/extras/Gif4.4_2.gif?t=1752767160"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Dynamic Gameplay & A Deep Storyline[/b][/p][list][*][p]Play as Mai in the different stages of her life, harnessing the unique abilities in childhood and adolescence to face the challenges ahead.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Experience a natural progression of gameplay mechanics, from precision platforming to hack and slash combat, while unlocking new abilities for Mai through Metroidvania-style progression, expanding her exploration and combat possibilities.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Over 20 hours of gameplay, featuring ancient caves to investigate, abandoned factories to discover and submerged worlds to explore.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Gather hidden clues with Mai to unravel the past, uncovering the events that led to humanity’s extinction, and discover what fate awaits the world after their disappearance.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The game is coming in September, stay tuned![/p][p][/p][p]For more, stay tuned on our Discord Server:[/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/chubbypixel"]https://discord.com/invite/chubbypixel[/url][/p]

notes.title: Woodle Tree 2: Deluxe+ today available for Steam!
notes.content:
Hello my friends!
[b]Woodle Tree 2: Deluxe+[/b] is now available on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1173740/Woodle_Tree_2_Deluxe/

You can get it now 15% OFF for few days! ːwoodleː
Gamers that bought the Woodle Tree 2: Worlds edition will receive a special owner discount of 20% on the game, stay tuned for this promotion!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36295543/b161427c71c9876e4d81bda6f26cd52cf8a1e541.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36295543/b161427c71c9876e4d81bda6f26cd52cf8a1e541.gif[/img][/url]

[b]What does include this new edition of the game?[/b]

· Platforming sections completely redesigned for the most hardcore gamers in this new Deluxe Edition

· Fast paced new abilities and puzzles

· Power ups and items to upgrade Woodle and the helpful Leaf

· local co-op in now improved and up to 4 players to experience the main adventure with your friends!

· New bizarre characters that you’ll meet meet during your quest: will they help or hinder you?



Also, The main game Includes the DLC "Sleepin' Flowers" with the new hard challenges!

Join the discord Server if you want to stay updated: https://discord.gg/y7zjrDd

I hope you'll have fun with this new edition!
Chubby Pixel
